jobs.occupation: Executive Assistant - International FMCG Company - Brussels
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international FMCG company based in Brussels, known for its portfolio of well-established consumer brands and collaborative working environment. With a strong presence across international markets, the company combines innovation, operational excellence, and a people-focused culture.

As an Executive Assistant your responsibilities are:

jobs.occupation: Order picker in night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you already need to live in Belgium for this job, preferably in the region of Oostkamp or Bruges. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you do not qualify !!

About this job
For a company active in the food industry, we are looking for a day cleaner. Your working day usually starts around 8:00 a.m. In this role, you ensure that the production and packaging areas, as well as the communal areas, are clean and hygienic every day.

Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? Are you already living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home almost every evening?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Average of 12h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Between 5 to 15 stops/day
• Never on weekends or on holidays
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence and code 95
• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Experience as a CE truck driver is a big advantage but not required. You can also apply if you've just gotten your CE driving licence!

jobs.occupation: Sales Associate - Chocolate Boutique - Bruges City Centre
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity in the heart of Bruges?

Do you want a job with real growth potential? Are you passionate about customer service and working with high-quality products?

Then this might be the perfect opportunity for you.

This renowned chocolate boutique, located in the historic centre of Bruges, specialises in premium Belgian chocolate and offers customers an authentic chocolate experience.

The shop is known for its wide selection of pralines, truffles, and other handcrafted chocolate delicacies, all made with passion and craftmanship.

We are currently looking for an enthusiastic and customer oriented Sales Associate to join their team.

Your daily responsibilities:

• Replenishing stock and maintaining attractive product displays
• Handling payments and operating the cash register
• Providing information about the product range
• Performing accurate stock control and monitoring expire dates
• Maintaining a warm and welcoming attitude at all times

• Perfect English and basic Dutch, but willingness to learn
• Willingness to work weekends (1 day off during the weekend)
• Temporary contract till 31/12/2026
French, Spanish, Russian, Chinese are also languages we are looking for.

We are currently looking for several profiles to work in a two-shift system or a fixed night shift in Zwevezele.

We are recruiting for the following positions:

• Press brake operators
• Forklift drivers
• Loaders and unloaders
• Overhead crane operators
• Saw machine operators
• General metalworking machine operators

Your profile

• You bring a healthy dose of enthusiasm and motivation.
• You have experience working with machines and a strong interest in technology, or experience operating a forklift.
• You have solid technical insight.
• You have a very good knowledge of Dutch and/or English.
• You are available to work Monday to Friday in a two-shift system or a fixed night shift.
Working hours:

• Morning shift: starts at 5:00 or 6:00 AM, depending on the department.
• Afternoon shift: starts at 1:00 or 2:00 PM.
• Night shift: starts on Monday evening at 9:00 or 10:00 PM. On Fridays, the schedule is adjusted so you start and finish earlier, allowing you to begin the weekend sooner.
